recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition featuring a high-contrast, sepia-toned close-up portrait of a man with styled hair, framed by a dark burgundy header and a thin gold horizontal rule. The subject's hand, adorned with leather and metal jewelry, is raised toward his head, creating a dynamic diagonal line against a soft, textured background.
coreVisualRelationships: The dark header bar anchors the top, providing a structured container for primary text.
The subject's gaze and hand position create a triangular focal point in the center-left.
The yellow script at the bottom provides a vibrant organic contrast to the rigid header typography.
coreInvariants: High-contrast chiaroscuro lighting on the face
A solid-colored horizontal band at the top edge
A thin, bright dividing line between the header and the image

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Close-up portrait occupying the lower 80% of the frame, slightly offset to the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark burgundy header bar at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top header, follows the subject's arm down to the face, and ends at the script text in the bottom corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Softly lit, out-of-focus area to the right of the subject's face.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Sepia and dark brown tones in the photography.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep burgundy/maroon for the header bar.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted gold/yellow for the script text and dividing line.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between shadows and highlights.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Condensed geometric sans-serif and expressive gestural script.
letterConstructionRules: Header text uses extreme tracking (letter spacing) and a tall, narrow aspect ratio.
Bottom text uses a fluid, connected script with varying line weights suggesting a brush or felt-pen.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'Y' in the script has a long, sweeping descender that underlines part of the word.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Rigid, spaced-out architectural sans-serif paired with a messy, organic handwritten script.

preserve: Extreme letter spacing in the header

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the tall, narrow, clean proportions of the header text.
Captures the 80s-era casual handwritten feel for the bottom text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast sepia-toned portrait of a man with 80s styled hair, hand near head wearing leather bracelets. Add a solid burgundy bar at the top with a thin gold line underneath.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place uppercase condensed sans-serif text with wide tracking inside the burgundy bar. Place yellow handwritten script text in the bottom left corner with a slight upward tilt.

verificationChecks: Is the header text extremely spaced out?
Is the photo sepia-toned with high contrast?
Is there a thin gold line separating the header from the photo?
Is the bottom text a yellow script?

adjustableVariables: Tracking distance of the header text
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the burgundy bar is perfectly horizontal.
Check that the gold line is exactly one pixel or very thin.
Verify the script text is legible against the dark areas of the photo.
Confirm the sepia tone is consistent across the entire image area.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a high-contrast moody portrait + add a dark top-bar header + use ultra-spaced condensed sans-serif for the title + add a bright organic script for the subtitle.
